name: docs-deployment-kubernetes-md-03
yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: rift
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: rift
          image: zainalpour/rift-proxy:latest
          args: ["--configfile", "/config/imposters.json"]
          ports:
            - name: admin
              containerPort: 2525
            - name: imposter
              containerPort: 4545
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config
              mountPath: /config
              readOnly: true
      volumes:
        - name: config
          configMap:
            name: rift-imposters
